evd_title: GPT-4 achieved 86.6% majority-vote accuracy on 119 NeurIPS checklist question-paper pairs
finding: GPT-4 achieved 86.6% majority-vote accuracy on 119 NeurIPS checklist question-paper pairs
P: 119 {checklist question, paper} pairs from 15 NeurIPS 2022 papers (OpenReview), author 'Yes' answers
I: GPT-4 (8k, API), zero-shot, relevant paper sections as input, majority vote of 3 responses
C: Hand-labeled ground truth (1 CS grad student); author-submitted checklist answers
O: Accuracy: GPT-4 86.6% vs authors 86.6%; 92.8% excluding figure-only items
T: NeurIPS 2022 papers; GPT-4 accessed 20-23 May 2023; paper 2023
